breakdown.description: The prompt forms the torsional strain energy with the bending second moment I instead of the polar moment J, which is inconsistent with torsion theory.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the polar moment of inertia J = πd⁴/32 for the torsional strain energy calculation. There is no mention of using the bending second moment I = πd⁴/64 in place of J. This matches the ground truth prompt, which only references J = πd⁴/32 and does not include the erroneous substitution of I for J.
